rows.grounds: instrumental plural of compound indrādi denoting Indra and other deities
instrumental plural of compound tat+astra referring to weapons of those deities
compound adjective describing something furnished with seven avaraṇas

items.question: What divine attendants, weapons, and enclosures characterize the supreme object being described?
premises: The described object is accompanied by Indra and other deities.
It is accompanied by the weapons of those deities.
It is endowed with seven enclosures.
items.inference: The supreme object is characterized by the presence of Indra and other deities, their weapons, and seven enclosures.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the described object depends on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: It is accompanied by Indra and other deities, and by their weapons, and is endowed with seven enclosures.
